title: keywords/{lang}.json — compiled keyword rules (ADR-005 Part 2)
description: Stage-1 keyword pre-filter rules. Patterns MUST conform to the portable regex subset (compiler stage 10). Every rule's intent must exist (stage 3).

tier.description: 1 = exact-utterance short-circuit; 2 = substring/pattern boost requiring classifier agreement.

guards.description: Negative guards: if any guard pattern matches, the rule does not fire.
